title: Claude Code usage
description: Claude Code's built-in OpenTelemetry export, weighted the same way as scripts/quota-share. Compare the first two panels with the Box dashboard's quota share panel; the hand-made script is retired only once they agree.

panels.title: Share of weighted 7-day usage by consumer
panels.description: Same weights as scripts/quota-share: input + 5*output + 1.25*cacheCreation + 0.1*cacheRead, x5/3 Opus/Fable, x1/3 Haiku. Share of the measured consumers (the captain's PC is not measured).

targets.expr: sum by (consumer) ((increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d]) or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d])*5 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d])*1.25 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d])*0.1)*5/3 or (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d]) or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d])*5 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d])*1.25 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d])*0.1)/3 or (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d]) or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d])*5 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d])*1.25 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d])*0.1)) / scalar(sum(sum by (consumer) ((increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d]) or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d])*5 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d])*1.25 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead",model=~".*(opus|fable).*"}[7d])*0.1)*5/3 or (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d]) or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d])*5 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d])*1.25 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead",model=~".*haiku.*"}[7d])*0.1)/3 or (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d]) or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d])*5 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d])*1.25 or increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead",model!~".*(opus|fable|haiku).*"}[7d])*0.1)))) * 100
